stance_rationale: Cycle57B is not reviewable as a completed Forge package: required WT_CYCLE57B stage artifacts and weights.csv are missing, Phase 4 is materially incomplete, and the draft claims outputs that do not exist. Code-only cleanup evidence exists for Phases 1-3, but it cannot substitute for the role prompt's Pure Function, walk-forward, lockbox, baseline, DSR, and chart audits.

critical_concerns.description: RF-F2/RF-F8/AX-002/PIT-C1/L-484: Phase 4 is incomplete. The draft claims 25 prediction files and an aggregate output, but the output directory contains only one prediction parquet, the runner log ends mid-seed without END/DONE, and cycle57b_q15_BBVA_indirect_fixed JSON/CSV/chart outputs are absent.

RF-F1/AX-002/PIT-C11/L-454: Pure Function evidence is not established. There is no hash_audit field or 3-package md5 PRE/POST audit, and Phase 3 audit metadata mislabels fred_macro_wide_FIXED as the original .cache/fred_macro_wide.parquet path.

RF-F2/RF-F7/AX-002/PIT-C1/L-129: Required stage artifacts are missing at both WT_CYCLE57B directories, and outputs/04_evaluation/weights.csv is absent. Therefore as_of_date schedule, alpha_scores time-series dimension, covariance PSD/condition <=100, and turnover/hard-constraint checks cannot be verified.

RF-F9/AX-002/PIT-C11/L-454: The publication-lag fix uses fixed calendar-day shifts and silently drops shifted observations whose release dates are not in the date spine. Verified non-NA losses include US_M2 315->261, Housing_Permits 315->264, and Init_Claims 1376->1348, so release-calendar correctness is not proven.

RF-F4/RF-F5/RF-F6/AX-008/PIT-C3/L-119: Baseline fairness, DSR penalty, and Harvey 5-spec evidence are absent. The aggregator script hardcodes historical reference PR-AUCs and does not provide same-period, same-cost, same-DSR, or 5-spec regression evidence.

critical_concerns.description: RF-F3/RF-F8/AX-002/PIT-C5/L-122: Lockbox and OOS visual evidence is absent. No equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, oos_zoom_chart.png, monthly_returns.parquet, or frozen extension evidence exists under the reviewed outputs.

supporting_arguments: Phase 1-3 scripts and audit JSONs exist, and parquet schema checks show fred_macro_wide_FIXED, A6_bbva_macro_FIXED, and FIXED2 feature panels were materialized.
Wrapper scripts point to the strict-PIT q15 template and expected FIXED2 panels, but only one seed output is present.
Phase 1 validation directly demonstrates the ICSA 2020-03-21 value shifted to 2020-03-26 and removed from the original date.
unresolved_disputes: Whether Cycle57B should be judged under the full Forge portfolio/backtest schema or a narrower code-only ML cleanup schema; the user-specified role prompt requires the full Forge checks.
Whether the missing WT_CYCLE57B stage artifacts and weights.csv are packaging omissions or evidence that this package is not a portfolio Forge package.
Whether fixed calendar-day lags without next-business-day release handling satisfy PIT-C11 for external time series.
Whether Phase 4 was still running after the captured log; the reviewed filesystem has no completion marker.
weakest_assumption: The most fragile claim is that a code-only input cleanup draft can be approved as Forge-complete before Phase 4 aggregation, stage artifacts, weights schedule, baseline fairness, DSR, and lockbox evidence are present.
rebuttal_required: Provide PRE/POST md5 hash audit for alpha_package, risk_package, optimization_package, target weights, alpha vector, and covariance inputs.
Provide the missing WT_CYCLE57B stage artifacts, weights.csv, alpha_scores.parquet, covariance.parquet, and PSD/condition diagnostics.
Complete Phase 4 with all 25 prediction files and produce the Cycle57B aggregate JSON/CSV/chart outputs.
Recompute same-period baselines with identical period, cost, and DSR penalty, or explicitly scope this package outside Forge performance comparison.
Show release-calendar or next-business-day handling for publication-lag shifts.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: No second-source PASS is possible because the package is incomplete and mandatory Forge artifacts are missing.
